title: Portfolio Manager
description: Decision support per strategy, from the PM Knowledge Base vault: review signals (P0/P1/P2), executable value, convexity class, gamma/theta efficiency, journal history. Never trades.

panels.title: P0 hard
panels.description: Strategies with a hard P0 review: thesis invalidated or risk budget breached. Bad prices are counted under Data flags instead.

panels.title: P1 time / profit
panels.description: Profit levels, DTE window, short leg near expiry.

panels.title: P2 drift / efficiency
panels.description: Delta, class change, GT_h below 1, low remaining reward.

panels.title: Data flags
panels.description: Strategies with a missing, stale or wide quote, or no greeks: their outcome is REVIEW - data unreliable.

panels.title: Cost to close all now
panels.description: Mid value minus executable value (sell at the bid, buy back at the ask), summed over strategies with quotes.

panels.title: Review queue (every strategy not on HOLD, highest priority first)
panels.description: The Portfolio Manager's review signals (vault rules) next to what the bot's own rules say. Click a strategy for its detail below. Manager: long options (opened for a debit) or short options (opened for a credit), not the convexity class. Review at DTE is the long manager's life-scaled window; Captured is the short manager's share of the credit kept. Order: what you can act on first. Priority is the most urgent signal other than bad data ("data" when bad data is the only one); real P0, then P1, then P2, each with clean rows before rows whose prices are flagged; rows with only bad data last. A flagged row still says REVIEW - data unreliable: check its prices before acting.

targets.expr: sum by (strategy, symbol, kind, manager, cls, outcome, top, signals, bot) (thetagang_pm_info{outcome!="HOLD"})

properties.value: The vault's DTE review window for this strategy's original life (T3).

targets.expr: sum by (strategy, structure, kind, manager, cls, outcome, bot) (thetagang_pm_info{strategy="$strategy"})

panels.title: Executable value
panels.description: Sell long legs at the bid, buy back shorts at the ask.

panels.title: GT 5-day
panels.description: Long convexity only: expected gamma gain over 5 trading days / theta paid, at forecast realised vol. Below 1: decay beats gamma (vault: gamma_theta_efficiency).

panels.title: Breakeven vol vs realised
panels.description: sigma_BE: the realised volatility at which gamma pays for theta over 5 days, vs the 21-day realised vol forecast. Long convexity wins when realised > breakeven.

panels.title: Remaining reward / risk
panels.description: (best value at expiry - executable value) / (executable value - worst value at expiry). Defined-risk strategies only.

panels.title: Worst-case loss
panels.description: The scenario grid's worst cell over 1, 5 and 10 trading days, both price families (vault risk_metrics WCL_h). P0 when it exceeds the loss budget.

panels.title: Thesis and budget (journal)
panels.description: Your inputs come from [[pm.strategies]] in the TOML (by strategy ID). Positions held before the journal started have an estimated entry.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(entry_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Entry", CASE WHEN entry_estimated THEN 'estimated' ELSE '' END AS " ", net_debit AS "Net debit ($)", initial_dte AS "DTE at entry", thesis AS "Thesis", invalidation_below AS "Invalid below", invalidation_above AS "Invalid above", target AS "Target ($)", max_loss AS "Max loss ($)", thesis_valid AS "Thesis valid", status AS "Status" FROM strategies WHERE id = '$strategy'
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, pnl_exec AS "executable", pnl_mid AS "mid" FROM snapshots WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy' AND $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) ORDER BY day

panels.title: Decision log
panels.description: One row each time this strategy's outcome or signals changed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "When (NY)", outcome AS "PM outcome", (SELECT string_agg((e->>'priority') || ' ' || (e->>'name') || ': ' || (e->>'detail'), '; ')  FROM jsonb_array_elements(signals) e) AS "Signals", bot_action AS "Bot rules said", your_action AS "You did" FROM decisions WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy' ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Legs (journal)
panels.description: Open legs first; closed legs show the roll history.

targets.rawSql: SELECT label AS "Contract", qty AS "Qty", entry_price AS "Entry price", to_char(opened_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Opened", to_char(closed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Closed" FROM strategy_legs WHERE strategy_id = '$strategy' ORDER BY closed_on IS NOT NULL, closed_on DESC, label

panels.title: Executable value by underlying (concentration)
panels.description: Sum of |executable value| of each underlying's strategies (vault: portfolio_management).

panels.title: Strategies with unreliable data
panels.description: Missing, crossed, stale or wide quotes, zero bids, no greeks (vault: data_quality_controls). Before the open most options show here.

panels.title: Trading rules in use ([pm] in the TOML)
panels.description: The settings that decide reviews and the bot's roll/close orders: profit, DTE, delta, efficiency and loss levels for both managers, and decide. Each with its vault register ID (assumptions_register; all hypotheses) and whether it is the default or your [pm] setting. Model and data settings (T7 tolerances, T9 quote limits, M1, M6), the superseded T2 and journal still act from the TOML but are not listed. Change them in the TOML and restart the monitor.

targets.expr: sum by (name, value, vault_id, source, meaning) (thetagang_pm_param{vault_id!~"T2|T7|T9|M[0-9]+", name!="journal"})

panels.title: Credit captured (short options)
panels.description: Share of the credit kept: (credit - cost to buy back now) / credit, at executable prices. S1: 50% review, 70% strong consideration, 80% default close, 90-100% normally close. Strategies opened for a credit only.

panels.title: Loss multiple (short options)
panels.description: (cost to buy back now - credit) / credit: 0 at breakeven, 1 when the loss equals the credit, negative in profit. S3 reviews at 1x / 2x / 3x. Strategies opened for a credit only.

panels.title: Premium left per $ of risk (short options)
panels.description: Remaining premium / remaining risk = cost to buy back now / worst-case loss (phase 1: down to the expiry floor, defined risk only). It falls late in a trade: each extra $ of premium costs more risk. Strategies opened for a credit only.

panels.title: WCL 1 day
panels.description: Worst grid loss over 1 trading day

panels.title: WCL 5 days
panels.description: Worst grid loss over 5 trading days

panels.title: WCL 10 days
panels.description: Worst grid loss over 10 trading days

panels.title: Stress loss
panels.description: Worst named stress scenario (gaps, IV shocks; VIX: spike, fade, regime shift). P0 when above the loss budget

panels.title: Loss budget
panels.description: max_loss + min(0, unrealised P&L): what is left of your risk budget (vault risk_metrics)

panels.title: E[P&L] 5 days
panels.description: Probability-weighted P&L: realised-vol forecast, zero drift, IV unchanged (M8). A model, not a promise

panels.title: Expected Shortfall
panels.description: Average loss in the worst 10% of outcomes (es_alpha) under the same probabilities

panels.title: U hold − U close
panels.description: Utility of holding minus closing now (vault roll_rules). Reported only, not a signal: with zero drift and IV unchanged it is negative almost by construction

panels.title: Scenario grid ($horizon trading days)
panels.description: P&L ($) of repricing every leg at the price move (rows; strikes are added near expiry) and IV shift (columns, IV points), after $horizon trading days, against today's model value (vault scenario_engine). Sensitivity, not probabilities. VIX options move on their own future, with VIX-sized moves (M11).

panels.title: Stress scenarios (1 day)
panels.description: Named scenarios beyond the grid, repriced over 1 trading day (vault stress_testing, M2; VIX regime scenarios M11). Sizes are hypotheses.

panels.title: Grid summary ($; count; ratio)
panels.description: Per horizon (vault scenario_engine): best, worst and median cell; adverse cells (count, sum); time decay = price and IV unchanged; IV sensitivity = IV up minus IV down one step; asymmetry = best / |worst|. The median of a grid is descriptive, not an expectation.

panels.title: HOLD / CLOSE / ROLL (reported, not a signal)
The model's view, every strategy
panels.description: The highest utility of HOLD, CLOSE and the best roll (vault roll_rules), under two probability models. IV fixed: zero drift, IV unchanged (M8). IV history: the underlying's own joint 5-day price and IV moves from days with IV in the same third of its trailing year, price demeaned and scaled to the realised-vol forecast, expected IV change halved. Compare the two; neither is validated. Reported, never a signal or an order. '–': no probabilities or quotes.

targets.expr: sum by (strategy, view, view_iv, best, scanned) (thetagang_pm_view)

panels.title: Roll candidates ($): $strategy
panels.description: The same structure at later expiries and shifted strikes (vault roll_rules), each judged as a new trade at executable prices: cost to open, its own scenario risk, and its utility after closing the old strategy. U roll = its utility - the cost of closing today's; vs hold = U roll - U hold. A strategy not on HOLD is scanned about every 30 minutes (roll_rescan_mins). Reported, never an order; VIX options have no utility (no probabilities), so compare their risk and cost. U roll IV and vs hold IV are the same comparison under the IV history model.

panels.title: IV rank
panels.description: Today's IV against its trailing year: 100% = the highest. IB's general IV for the underlying, not this strategy's contracts

panels.title: Expected IV change
panels.description: Mean 5-day IV change from days with IV in the same third of the trailing year, halved (iv_view_shrink). Points. A hypothesis on thin evidence

panels.title: E[P&L] IV history
panels.description: Expected 5-day P&L under the IV history model. Compare with E[P&L] above (IV unchanged)

panels.title: ES IV history
panels.description: Expected Shortfall under the IV history model: average loss in the worst 10% of samples

panels.title: U hold − U close, IV history
panels.description: HOLD minus CLOSE under the IV history model. Reported only

panels.title: Samples
panels.description: Historical 5-day windows behind the IV history model

panels.title: Largest sticky-delta gap
panels.description: The largest difference between sticky-delta and sticky-strike P&L across the price moves, after 5 trading days. The grid uses sticky strike, so this is its model risk (vault volatility_scenarios)

panels.title: Legs inside the smile
panels.description: The share of this strategy's legs inside the quoted strikes of a measured smile. A leg without a smile, or far from the money, shows little or no gap however skewed the market is: a low share means the gap understates the risk

panels.title: Pricing
panels.description: 1: American with dividends, IV re-implied so the model sits at the mid. 0: European, until the underlying's dividends load, and for index and VIX options

panels.title: Sticky delta minus sticky strike ($, 5 trading days)
panels.description: If IV stays with moneyness instead of with the strike, how the P&L at each price move changes (vault volatility_surface). From a small smile per held expiry: about 5 strikes around the money, refreshed about every 30 minutes; interpolated, flat past the quotes. Model risk, not a forecast or a signal.

panels.title: Forward test: what the model said, and what happened
Results by the model's view
panels.description: Each forecast against the same position 5 recorded days later, legs unchanged. Held, realised: the change in executable value, what holding made over closing that day. If the CLOSE view means anything, CLOSE rows should do worse than HOLD rows. Positions that closed or expired before the 5 days are not in here, and the days overlap, so far fewer independent results than rows. Empty until 5 trading days have passed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model AS "Model", v AS "View", count(*) AS "Results", round(avg(predicted)::numeric, 0) AS "Predicted ($)", round(avg(realised)::numeric, 0) AS "Held, realised ($)", round(100.0 * avg((realised > 0)::int), 0) AS "Beat closing (%)", round(100.0 * avg(beyond_wcl::int), 0) AS "Past the 5-day worst (%)" FROM (SELECT 'IV fixed' AS model, view AS v, e_pnl AS predicted, realised_exec AS realised, beyond_wcl FROM forecast_results UNION ALL SELECT 'IV history', view_iv, e_pnl_iv, realised_exec, beyond_wcl FROM forecast_results) r WHERE v <> '-' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Recorded so far
panels.description: The forward test, in the journal since 2026-11-06. One row per strategy per day, the day's last good quotes. Useful results take months, and cover only your positions and this market period.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT day) FROM forecasts) AS "Days recorded", (SELECT count(*) FROM forecasts) AS "Forecasts", (SELECT count(*) FROM forecast_results) AS "Results so far", (SELECT count(*) FROM roll_forecasts) AS "Roll candidates", (SELECT count(*) FROM leg_marks) AS "Leg marks", (SELECT to_char(max(day), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM forecasts) AS "Latest"
